2.description: You are arrested and sent to prison. You must muster out, and any Benefit rolls from this term are forfeit.

3.description: A job goes spectacularly wrong. Gain an Enemy and lose all Benefit rolls from this term.

4.description: You betray — or are betrayed by — a partner in crime. Gain them as an Enemy.

5.description: A rival criminal organisation targets you and you are forced to flee or go straight. Muster out.

3.description: A job goes wrong and you are pursued by the law. Roll Stealth 8+ or Deception 8+ to escape. On failure, roll on the Mishap Table (not ejected). Either way, gain an Enemy in law enforcement.

4.description: You befriend a fence, crime boss, or fellow criminal. Gain a Contact or Ally in the underworld.

5.description: You pull off a lucrative heist. Gain DM+2 to any one Benefit roll.

6.description: You spend time working the shadows of a particular world. Gain one of Streetwise 1, Stealth 1, Deception 1 or Persuade 1.

8.description: You are given a delicate job by a major criminal syndicate. Roll Stealth 8+ or Deception 8+; on success, gain a Contact in the syndicate and DM+2 to your next Advancement. On failure, gain an Enemy and roll on the Mishap Table (not ejected).

9.description: You clash with law enforcement. Roll Streetwise 8+ or Gun Combat 8+ to escape; on failure, gain an Enemy in the Agents and a Rival on the streets.

10.description: You earn a reputation in the underworld. Gain DM+2 to your next Advancement roll.

11.description: You acquire specialist knowledge or equipment. Either gain one level of Gun Combat, Stealth, Electronics or Melee, or DM+4 to your next Advancement roll.

12.description: You pull off a caper that becomes legendary. You are automatically promoted and gain DM+2 to any one Benefit roll.
